setup: "n8n Form Trigger" (formTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

Workflow secret HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN: Hugging Face access token for api-inference.huggingface.co (Authorization: Bearer <secret>). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Provide run inputs: Prompt to flux, Style.

hints: The original started from a form submission; pass the form fields as run inputs.
"Call hugginface inference api" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
"Upload image to S3": the original used AWS S3; check the mapped aws-s3/AWSS3_UPLOAD_FILE params before running.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect aws-s3: `cdecli credential create -n "aws-s3" -p aws-s3 --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
### Set style prompt
Each Edit fields node after the Switch sets `stylePrompt`, used in huggingface node.

### Run flux model
In `Call huggingface inference api` You can change `black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell` in URL parameter to other models:
- `black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev`
- `Shakker-Labs/FLUX.1-dev-LoRA-AntiBlur`
- `XLabs-AI/flux-RealismLora`
- `ByteDance/Hyper-SD`

[See more models on huggingface.co](https://huggingface.co/models?pipeline_tag=text-to-image&sort=trending)

### Host image on S3
[Cloudflare](https://cloudflare.com) has free S3 compatible hosting. They call it "R2".

### Respond to Form
Serve a webform with image on success. On error, send message to form.

### Serve form to user
Captures `Prompt to flux` and `Style` from user.
